title: Full Body Superset
description: Full-body supersets pairing push-pull and squat-hinge combos in 3 sets for a complete strength session

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Prone Y raises
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, arms in a Y shape, lift and hold 2s

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide apart, toes pointed outward

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: On one leg, hinge the torso forward, back leg extended

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows pointing back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, arms by your sides, sweep in an arc along the floor

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
